content.title: Karol G at Coachella 2026: Start Time, Setlists and Special Guests for Weekend Two
content.text: Weekend one of Coachella 2026 wrapped with plenty of highlights. Sabrina Carpenter delivered a theatrical, Hollywood-themed headliner set, while Justin Bieber returned with a reflective, comeback-style performance. But it was Karol G making history—as the first Latina to headline the festival. Karol G closed weekend one of Coachella 2026 with a high-energy set that blended reggaeton, mariachi and pop into a vivid celebration of Latin identity. She mixed hits with newer material, supported by elaborate choreography, set design, costume changes and guest appearances from fellow Latino artists. The performance balanced spectacle with message as she emphasized representation and immigrant pride, cementing the show as a defining Coachella moment.Discover Time Out original videoNapa Rose For weekend two, expectations are high, with speculation running rampant about special guests. Here’s everything you need to know about Karol G’s headlining performance during weekend two of Coachella. What day is Karol G performing at Coachella? Karol G is set to headline on Sunday, April 19 following her headlining performance on the Coachella stage last Sunday, April 12. What time will Karol G play the Main Stage? Karol G is scheduled to perform at 10:10pm, after Major Lazer and Young Thug Has Karol G played Coachella before? Yes. Karol G previously performed at Coachella in 2022, where she delivered a high-profile set that included surprise guests and helped solidify her presence with U.S. festival audiences. That performance marked a key step in her crossover trajectory. Has Karol G’s setlist for Coachella been announced yet? During her weekend one performance, Karol G covered a full range of material, from hits like “Tusa” and “Provenza” plus newer tracks like the live debut of “Ese Hombre es Malo” (performed with a live mariachi band). Her set was interspersed with declarations of pride and support of the Latino community. Expect her second weekend setlist to include more of the hits. Will any guests be joining Karol G’s Coachella set? Fans were thrilled that Karol G brought collaborators Becky G and Mariah Angelique to perform “Mamiii” and “El Makinon” respectively. Other guests included reggaeton star Wisin and Cigarettes After Sex’s Greg Gonzalez. Rumored to be joining Karol G on weekend two are J Balvin, Kali Uchis and even superstars Bad Bunny and Shakira. Fingers crossed. Can I live stream Karol G’s Coachella set? Yes. Coachella will live stream performances on YouTube’s live Coachella channels both weekends, including major main stage sets. For weekend two, you can watch Karol G on Sunday from 10:10 to 11:55pm on the main stage feed below. What’s the rest of the Coachella 2026 schedule like?
